aggregation: Each status separate. Means over present values only; n explicit. Conductor 0 denotes graph aggregate, not a stratum. Timeout counters are unknown, not zero. Duplicate workload/arm/round/seed and cross-binary pooling are refused.
wall_claim: RAW_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; profile/isolation are in sealed records; no admitted runtime comparison

yield_definitions.decomposition_calls: targets_tried - repeated_targets_skipped for these classic guarded walk arms; identity skips occur before trial increment
yield_definitions.oracle_call_relation_yield: relations_found / decomposition_calls; absent when calls are zero or unknown
yield_definitions.relation_yield: Legacy alias: relations per nonidentity source trial, including duplicate queries skipped before the oracle. Not relations per oracle call.
